flags.why: The meaning 'to fall; to drop' is mainly Central and Southern usage, as documented in this [linguistic study](https://www.thuvienlamdong.org.vn/Files/Books/163080.pdf).
'Thông' does not mean 'to be sufficient', and 'Lúa gạo thông ăn cả năm' is not valid Vietnamese.
'Nhân trời mưa' cannot naturally express rain forcing a trip to be postponed, because 'nhân' introduces an occasion or opportunity for an action.
